summary: Kimi Antonelli hunts his maiden world championship at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, where illness forces him to skip Thursday's media duties despite standing on the brink of glory. The thin air and punishing corners of Mexico City will test tire strategies and fuel management as midfield rivals scramble to capitalize on any championship contender misstep. A victory here would seal Antonelli's coronation, but a slip could reignite the title fight and hand momentum to his closest challengers heading into the final rounds.
